answer: A practical sybil defense roots each identity in a seasonal willow cycle of verifiable growth. Each agent must extend its shale ledger with a new growth ring per epoch, where each ring commits to the prior epoch's state. The orchard of consensus verifies each ring; any gap or fork invalidates the identity. An attacker deploying 500 clones must sustain 500 independent growth histories — costing ~$5000/epoch — while an honest agent adds one ring per epoch. A willow with missing rings is rejected; a shale with fractured layers is discarded; a barren orchard voids the identity.
